items.q: Is converting PDF to Markdown free?
items.a: Yes, converting PDF to Markdown is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: How is this different from PDF to Text?
items.a: PDF to Text gives you the raw extracted text. PDF to Markdown analyzes font sizes and layout to detect real structure — headings, bullet and numbered lists, and simple tables — and writes it as proper Markdown syntax. It's a best-effort structural reading of the document, not a guess at structure that isn't really there.

items.q: Does it work on scanned or image-only PDFs?
items.a: Not directly — a scanned page has no extractable text to analyze. Run it through the OCR PDF tool first, then convert the OCR'd result to Markdown.

Simple, consistently-aligned tables are detected and converted to Markdown table syntax. Merged cells, nested tables, or inconsistent spacing may not convert cleanly — check the output for anything table-heavy.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
